_description: AI integration decisions: provider registry, prompt architecture, output parsing. Append only; supersede with a new entry instead of editing.

title: Registry-based factory pattern for AI providers
context: Adding a provider should not require touching multiple files or central switch statements. Alternatives considered: switch statement in factory; config-driven provider loading.
decision: Providers self-register via registerProvider(name, factory); getAIProvider() looks up by runtimeConfig.ai.provider.
rationale: Adding a new provider should require only one new file. No changes to existing code, no switch statements, no config files to update.
consequences_positive: Four providers (Anthropic, Gemini, OpenAI, Ollama) added with zero changes to other files

title: Providers return raw text; callers own JSON parsing
context: Different callers need different parsing strategies; centralizing parsing in providers couples them to specific output formats. Alternatives considered: provider-level JSON parsing; generic structured output mode.
decision: Providers return raw completion text. JSON extraction lives in server/utils/parseAIJson.ts.
rationale: Different callers need different parsing strategies. Centralizing parsing in the provider would couple it to specific output formats.
consequences_positive: parseAIJson.ts handles markdown-wrapped JSON and LLM quirks in one place

title: Prompts are pure functions returning {system, user} strings
context: Want prompts to be testable, versionable, and provider-independent. Alternatives considered: provider-specific prompt formats; template strings in endpoint handlers.
decision: Prompt builders live in server/services/ai/prompts/ as pure functions of (inputs) -> { system, user }.
rationale: Decouples prompt logic from provider implementation. Easy to test, iterate, and version prompts independently.
consequences_positive: Prompts are testable in isolation; same prompt works across all providers

title: Added Gemini provider
context: Wanted more provider options for cost/perf trade-offs. Alternative considered: stick with Anthropic only.
decision: Implement server/services/ai/gemini.ts and register at module load.
rationale: Expand provider options. Gemini offers competitive performance at lower cost for some use cases.
consequences_positive: Users can switch providers via NUXT_AI_PROVIDER env var

title: Added clearCache() to OllamaProvider for dev use
context: Local Ollama KV cache caused stale behavior during prompt iteration. Alternatives considered: manual curl to Ollama API; restart Ollama process.
decision: Expose a clearCache() dev convenience method on OllamaProvider that unloads the model from memory.
rationale: During local development, the Ollama KV cache can cause stale behavior. clearCache() unloads the model from memory.
consequences_negative: REMINDER: remove clearCache() before deploying to production.
